339-677-7297-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3175-6495-8207.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3175-6495-8207.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2624-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2624-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

215-4231-5444-7824.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2104-4499-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Emiel the Blessed.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4013-4659-5004-6643-7646.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

5153-7012-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
5153-7012-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Airbender Ascension's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Airbender Ascension's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

423-573-1437-1993--85.easyPrerequisites:
Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
You control nine or fewer lands.
423-573-1437-1993--85.description:
Cast Budoka Gardener by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Budoka Gardener spell three times.
Resolve the first Budoka Gardener copy.
Activate the Budoka Gardener token by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

950-1486-1753-7176.description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Fatestitcher to gain all creature types.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat from step 2.
950-1486-1753-7176.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1251-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1251-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2459-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4050-4314-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4314-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1315-5478-5721-6883.easyPrerequisites: There are at least six land cards between your graveyard and the battlefield under your control, one of which must be a Swamp, that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
1315-5478-5721-6883.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing any land, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least six land cards in your graveyard, with one of those cards being a Swamp.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}{G}.
Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

2014-2292-3055.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Yosei.
When Yosei dies, it and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing the next player in turn order to skip their next untap step.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
At the beginning of the end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Yosei.
Repeat during each turn unless you are the next player in turn order.

49-2034-2267-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.
49-2034-2267-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

2034-2558-3490-3698-6701.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-3698-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

222-2060-4050-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 3 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-4050-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable, adding {B}, {R} or {G} for each creature sacrificed.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Activate Crystalline Crawler up to three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding up to {B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-4050-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1737-4853-5004-5256.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1753-2457-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1753-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2533-3388-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
Repeat.

5391-5668-5870-5874.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2557-4871-5189.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or there is a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control.
2557-4871-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2440-2703-4885.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

914-4183-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
914-4183-4222.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.

778-2837-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Ancient Copper Dragon does not have summoning sickness.
778-2837-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Copper Dragon.
Breath of Fury and Ancient Copper Dragon triggers.
Resolve the Ancient Copper Dragon trigger, causing you to roll a d20 and create that many 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite Cat tokens, you may instead make Dog tokens using Jinnie Fay or Treasure tokens.

1247-2092-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
You control at least one basic land.
1247-2092-2757.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pili-Pala, untapping the basic land.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it for Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

366-1407-2615.notablePrerequisites: You control less than two Constructs.
366-1407-2615.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Purphoros triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Purphoros trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

549-4096-4853.notablePrerequisites:
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other nontoken artifact creature.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
549-4096-4853.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing any artifact creature you control and returning any other artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The sacrificed creature dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

463-1651-4231-4659.description:
Activate Magnifying Glass's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Magnifying Glass.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two of the tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

914-5003-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

269-1249-1494.notablePrerequisites: Sage of Hours has the lowest toughness or is tied for the lowest toughness among creatures you control.
269-1249-1494.description:
Cast Sandsteppe Mastodon by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Sandsteppe Mastodon enters the battlefield, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the begging of your upkeep, Stampeding Wildebeests triggers, causing you to return Sandsteppe Mastodon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

360-3957-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
360-3957-4702.description:
Activate Famished Paladin by tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Paladin.
Token copy of Famished Paladin enters the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

45-1987-2510-3277.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
45-1987-2510-3277.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
